priorityList: Pre-combat: Summon Felguard and use Power Siphon and Demonbolt to prepare resources.
Use your Potion and Power Infusion while Summon Demonic Tyrant is active.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials during Summon Demonic Tyrant.
Cast Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer Demonic Core stacks.
Cast Grimoire: Felguard (or Grimoire: Fel Ravager) on cooldown.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant on cooldown.
In AoE, cast Implosion if you have 6 or more Wild Imps active.
Cast Hand of Guldan whenever you have 3 or more Soul Shards.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Demonbolt if you have a Demonic Core stack and fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
If talented into Doom, prioritize casting Demonbolt on targets that do not have the Doom debuff.
Use Shadow Bolt as a filler to generate Soul Shards when no other actions are available.
